content:
Alex (support): Samira from KiteLabs reported repeated 503/504s on hosted inference this morning. customer sees failures when sending ~10-20k token prompts with streaming enabled. says SDK retries are looping and incurring charges. attaching sample request id: req_0a1b2c3d

Samira (customer): We hit this consistently from 08:15-08:45 PT, about 30% of requests. sometimes stream starts then drops with 504. using ruby-sdk v1.4.2. can provide logs.

Ben (eng-runtime): Thanks — can you paste a minimal repro request (headers + body size) and the SDK call? Also want the correlation-id from our gateway logs (x-rw-cid) if available.

Samira (customer): sample curl: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-medium","stream":true, "input":"<~12k tokens payload>"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
correlation id from client: kite-2026-03-17-08-21-15

Alex (support): got it, thanks. I see SDK is set to aggressive retries default (exponential with 3 retries). I'll ask eng for repro.

Jin (sre): I queried the ingress for that window. Edge shows many upstream 502s and connection resets. TL;DR: ingress -> proxy -> runtime. Proxy logs show `upstream prematurely closed connection` around 30s for those requests. Could be Keepalive or large request body streaming interaction.

Ben (eng-runtime): Noted. Two hypotheses: 1) long-running streaming requests hit an upstream idle timeout in the proxy; 2) KV cache or batch lock contention causing the runtime to abort the worker and close conn. Need runtime logs for the exact req id.

Devon (devex): Could the token rotation we rolled yesterday be amplifying auth churn? If clients are reconnecting mid-stream to refresh tokens that could cause half-closed streams. Samira, are you rotating tokens frequently?

Samira (customer): We rotate every 15m via our internal flow. We didn't change rotation this morning.

Alex (support): Repro plan: 1) Samira to run the curl above with `X-Debug-Trace: kite-xyz` header. 2) We'll tail gateway+runtime logs for that trace, correlate x-rw-cid. 3) If repro happens, we'll try disabling client retries and confirm whether retry fanout is worsening queueing.

Samira (customer): Running now — will post trace in ~5m.

(5m) Samira (customer): Trace kite-xyz-001: request failed with 504 after 31s. client shows retry, then second attempt 504 too.

Jin (sre): I pulled trace kite-xyz-001. Gateway accepted connection, proxied to runtime, then got `RST_STREAM` from runtime after 30.9s. Upstream response status logged as 502 from runtime worker that exited with OOM? runtime stderr shows `WARNING: batch worker preempted: queue depth exceeded` for same interval.

Ben (eng-runtime): Interesting — batch worker preempted warnings correlate with a new batching policy we shipped last week for long-context pinning. Looks like long-context requests sometimes trigger an eviction of the worker when queue depth spikes. Eviction path currently closes connections rather than returning graceful 5xx with retry-delay hints.

Devon (devex): That would explain client retries making it worse — retry fanout increases queue depth, pushing more workers over threshold. Suggested short-term mitigations: 1) reduce client retry attempts to 1 for streaming endpoints, 2) add `Prefer: retry-after` header or `x-rw-soft-fail` signal so clients can back off, 3) route long-context requests to model-variant `redwood-medium-long` that bypasses aggressive batching.

Ben (eng-runtime): For quick infra mitigation, we can increase the preemption threshold on the pooling controller for the next 2 hours in us-west to avoid immediate evictions. I'll prepare a patch.

Jin (sre): Also increasing proxy `proxy_read_timeout` to 90s for streaming routes will avoid premature RST when runtime is doing cleanup. I'll open a change with a rollback window.

Alex (support): Drafting a customer message — will share for review: "Hi Samira — we identified that long-streaming requests + retry fanout caused batch worker preemption leading to connection resets (502/504). We're deploying a short-term fix (increase preemption threshold + proxy timeout). Please temporarily set SDK retries=1 for streaming, and we recommend routing long inputs to long-context variant. We'll update in 30m." Thoughts? :thumbsup:

Ben (eng-runtime): LGTM. Also add: we're adding a runtime metric to track preemption count by model variant.

Devon (devex): Suggest phrasing for developers: "If you must rotate tokens frequently, try using keepalive token refresh or refresh only between requests to avoid mid-stream reconnects."

Samira (customer): Thanks. We'll try disabling retries and route long requests to the long-context model.

(30m) DeployBot: rolled change infra/ingress/proxy: increase proxy_read_timeout to 90s for streaming routes in us-west — success.

(35m) Ben (eng-runtime): Pushed runtime config bump to increase preemption threshold for batch controller in us-west. Monitoring preemption metric now.

(45m) Jin (sre): Early signal: 08:30-09:00 window preemption rate down 78% and 5xx from this tenant down to 2%. p95 latency stable.

Alex (support): Sent update to Samira: "We deployed short-term mitigations — can you confirm if you're still seeing 5xx? If you notice anything, include a debug trace id."

Samira (customer): After changes I ran 50 test requests — 1 failure (timeout) which succeeded on retry after 10s. overall much better. thanks.

Alex (support): Recording follow-ups: - ENG-5473 runtime: change preemption to soft-fail path (return 429+Retry-After) - SRE-6121 ingress: make streaming timeout granular and alert on preemption spikes - DEVEX-318: SDK default retries for streaming -> 1 and doc update - Comms: notify customers with long-context workloads about variant `redwood-medium-long`.

Ben (eng-runtime): I'll own ENG-5473. plan: change worker eviction to return structured retry hint and avoid hard RST. target PR today.

Jin (sre): I'll own SRE-6121 and add dashboard panels for preemption per region.

Alex (support): Closing loop with Samira now. Thanks everyone.

Samira (customer): Appreciate the fast help — will reach out if anything else pops up.

Alex (support): Marking thread resolved for now. Will reopen if we see regressions. :rocket:
